title: The Keeling Curve: Re-check a 1976 Finding
subject: Climate Science
summary: Keeling et al. (1976) reported that annual average CO₂ at Mauna Loa rose 3.4% between 1959 and 1971. Recompute that rise from today's NOAA record, quantify the recent growth rate, and apply the method to raw monthly data.
dataset_source: NOAA Global Monitoring Laboratory, Mauna Loa CO₂ annual and monthly means, via the datasets/co2-ppm mirror
license: Data: ODC-PDDL-1.0 (public domain). Paper: CC BY (open access). Mission text: CC-BY-4.0, Team PJ.
prerequisites: Spreadsheet or Python basics (helpful, not required)
reproduction_scope: Partial: the 1959→1971 percentage rise of the annual mean and recent growth rates, computed from NOAA's current record. The 1976 paper's own calibration and data processing are NOT reproduced, so a small, explainable difference from 3.4% is expected.
requirements: Any modern browser. A spreadsheet (Google Sheets, Excel, LibreOffice) or Python.
review_scope: Reference values recomputed by two independent implementations
Published value cross-check with documented deviation

datasets.title: Mauna Loa CO₂ monthly mean, 1958-03 to 2026-09
